title: Tech Note: 4D Load Launcher
author: Timothy Aaron Penner, Senior Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: This note's technique — launching many isolated 4D Client instances from a single controlling UI via LAUNCH EXTERNAL PROCESS to generate local load for benchmarking — is a still-workable, if dated, approach for basic client-server load testing; more rigorous performance testing today would typically use dedicated load-testing tools or cloud-based multi-machine setups rather than a single-machine multi-instance launcher, but the note's core idea remains sound for quick local benchmarking.
related_updates: 4D and third parties have since offered more sophisticated load-testing approaches, including cloud-based and headless testing setups
LAUNCH EXTERNAL PROCESS and isolated client resource folders remain valid mechanisms in current 4D
